newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile pension funds post one pct return in January.
newsitem.headline: Chile pension funds post one pct return in January.

text.p: Chile's privately run pension funds reported a one percent return on assets in January as the result of the rally in the Santiago stock market, said the pension fund managers superintendency.
"The profitability of one percent in January is explained essentially by share valuations," said the statement.
Most of last month's returns was the result of the sharp rises in heavyweight electricity stocks which account for a large part of the funds' equity investments, it said.

The system has reported average returns of 12.2 percent a year since its launch in 1981. But returns have fallen steeply in recent years, and private funds reported returns of 2.7 percent in the last 12 months to January.
The administrators manage portfolios of around $28 billion with their funds swelling by $300 million a month.
